'''December 2001 Sydney tournament (9 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sydney, Australia on 9 December 2001. [[Tyng Yann Yenn]] won it. It is known from Jason Baretta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3154">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-09-sydney-9-12-01d3154/ sydney-9-12-01], DeckTech (jason "zwitter" baretta, 9 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-09-sydney-9-12-01d3154/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Tyng Yann Yenn]]
